platform.title: The Enterprise AI Platform Behind Every Feature
platform.sub: Each visible AI feature is powered by a production-grade infrastructure that handles orchestration, validation, security, and observability automatically.
platform.calloutStrong: The AI feature may be visible to the user.
platform.calloutRest: The infrastructure that makes it scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable operates entirely behind the scenes.

integration.title: Three Ways to Integrate Murphi.ai
integration.sub: Choose the approach that matches how your platform is built—or combine all three.

cards.title: Embedded Components
cards.desc: Add AI directly into existing screens and clinical workflows without redirecting users to a separate tool.

cards.title: APIs & Workflow Services
cards.desc: Connect Murphi.ai capabilities to EHR data, documents, and actions through a clean, documented API layer.

cards.title: White-Labeled AI Platform

steps.text: EHR data, referral documents, or ambient voice captured at point of care
AI extracts, normalizes, and structures relevant clinical information
Missing elements and compliance gaps are flagged for clinician attention
Clinician reviews, edits, and approves the AI-generated output
Approved output is written into the EHR record at the field level
